What is Sus Cup?

Sus Cup is a community-organized Uma Musume tournament series created to record and celebrate competitive races between players.

The tournament tracker was made as a complete historical archive for every Sus Cup, preserving each race's details, participants, Uma Musume entries, complete results, champions, and all-time records.

Each Sus Cup has its own race conditions, track, distance, participants, and final results. The purpose of this website is to ensure that every tournament remains permanently documented and that the achievements of players and their Umas are remembered.

The tracker records:
  • Every Sus Cup tournament
  • Race dates and room IDs
  • Track and race conditions
  • All participating players
  • All Uma Musume entries
  • Complete finishing positions
  • NPC/Mob Uma participants
  • Character versions and special outfits
  • Individual Sus Cup champions
  • All-time winning players and Umas
  • Full tournament history

This website is not based on a points system. Its purpose is to create a permanent historical record of the Sus Cup tournament series and celebrate every race, competitor, champion, and winning Uma.
